msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.evaluation_point: after each deterministic fit trial and before ranking, acceptance, probability production, or serialization; frozen artifacts are revalidated before use
msfdr_mixture_validity_contract.floating_point_basis: Sage stores and fits hyperscores and skew-normal parameters as IEEE-754 binary64. A numerical-resolution unit is 64*f64::EPSILON*max(observed absolute score, observed score range, 1). The factor 64 covers the fixed sequence of subtraction, moment, square-root, and skew-normal transforms without creating a data-derived scientific cutoff.

input.nondegenerate_population: observed range and stable population standard deviation must both be greater than the numerical-resolution unit

parameters.component_scale: strictly greater than the numerical-resolution unit
parameters.one_sample_weights: a and 1-a must each be greater than weight_resolution
parameters.two_sample_weights: a, 1-a, a*s2_balance, b, and 1-a*s2_balance-b must each be greater than weight_resolution
parameters.effective_support: each fitted three-parameter skew-normal component must have expected aggregate support >= 3 observations; this is the number of free component parameters, not an empirical power threshold

identifiability.component_distinctness: for every semantically distinct component pair, at least one of location, scale, or shape must differ by more than 64*f64::EPSILON times the corresponding parameter scale; location and scale also use the observed-score resolution
identifiability.canonical_order: 1SMix retains its existing deterministic upper-tail orientation. 2SMix labels are fixed by their non-exchangeable joint roles and deterministic initialization. No mean-order constraint is added because the primary author implementation defaults to unconstrained component locations and such a condition would alter the estimator.
identifiability.nested_model_improvement: no positive likelihood-ratio cutoff is added: Peng et al. and the author implementation do not specify one, and distinct, effectively supported component parameters are identifiable in the declared family. Numerically equal likelihoods caused by coincident components are already rejected by the parameter-resolution rule.

outcomes.valid_fitted_mixture: all checks pass; fitted parameters are returned unchanged
outcomes.reduced_model: not supported by MSFDR1-SMIX or MSFDR2-SMIX; a boundary-weight solution is not relabelled as a successful reduced model
outcomes.nonidentifiable_fit: returns an explicit technical failure and produces no model or p-value/PEP/q-value stream
outcomes.optimizer_failure: no prospectively configured fit trial produced an otherwise valid model; distinct from nonidentifiability in the failure reason
outcomes.fallback: none inside these model fitters; workflow/Ensemble handling may only use existing explicit technical-failure provenance
